title: Predicted-Class Stability and Transport of Discharge-Disposition Models Among ICU Stays With Sepsis at 24, 48, and 72 Hours: A Three-Database Study of Recalibration and Enhanced-Monitoring Trigger Simulation
title_zh: 脓毒症出院去向预测模型的稳定性与运输：一项包含重校准与复评策略模拟的三数据库研究
research_question: How stable are discharge-destination predictions at 24, 48, and 72 h after sepsis ICU admission, and do fixed-weight transport, local recalibration, and reassessment triggers behave consistently across three critical-care databases?

database_roles.mimic4: contemporary single-center database and one side of the cross-institution replication
database_roles.eicu: multi-hospital database and complementary side of the cross-institution replication; also used for hospital-held-out internal-external validation
database_roles.mimic3: same-institution, different-era replication; not independent external validation

claim_boundaries.stability_estimand: the proportion still unstable through 72 h; not an exact time-to-stability distribution
claim_boundaries.mimic3: same-institution cross-era replication, not independent external validation
claim_boundaries.eicu_hospital_holdout: retrospective internal-external validation, not prospective validation
claim_boundaries.transport: retrospective fixed-weight database-to-database transport, not prospective deployment validation
claim_boundaries.reassessment: retrospective decision simulation, not clinical utility, workflow benefit, or prospective implementation evidence
claim_boundaries.recalibration_status: one stay per patient with patient-disjoint calibration and evaluation; mean 72 h top-label ECE 0.134-0.181 at 25 labels and 0.022-0.029 at 200 labels

eicu_sources.bp_rule: prefer invasive within the same hour, otherwise noninvasive

mapping.1: Facility, with database-specific hospice and against-advice mapping

outcome_primary.death_rule: hospital_expire_flag = 1 or an explicit DEAD/DIED discharge location; surviving HOSPICE discharges are facility

cohort.inclusion: adult sepsis; MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-III first ICU stay per hospital admission; eICU-CRD first ICU unit visit per patient
cohort.stability_condition_statement: explicitly conditional; not extrapolated to the whole sepsis population
cohort.eicu_text_definition: ICD-9 sepsis codes plus diagnosis text containing sepsis or septic; broad and reported as a limitation

mimic3.pooling: not pooled with the primary cohorts
mimic3.weight_transport: included as source and target in three of the six fixed-weight transport directions; not independent external validation

training.xgboost_fold_scope: primary analysis uses one patient-grouped five-fold partition shared by all landmarks in the complete three-landmark cohort
training.xgboost_sensitivity_fold_scope: landmark-specific eligible populations and patient-grouped folds retained as a sensitivity analysis

eicu_hospital_validation.scope: patients observed at more than one hospital in the validation cohort are excluded; one hospital-grouped five-fold partition is shared by 24, 48, and 72 h
eicu_hospital_validation.interpretation: retrospective internal-external validation, not prospective validation

training.seeds_scope: DG-GRU configurations use three seeds; XGBoost uses one fixed random seed with shared complete-cohort folds
training.pilot_use: five exploratory MIMIC-IV single-fold runs only; not used for nested tuning or model selection

metrics.stratification_rule: use confidence available at the decision landmark (24 h), never the later landmark

uncertainty.estimand: evaluation-sample uncertainty conditional on fitted out-of-fold predictions and cross-validation folds; training uncertainty is not resampled

transport.protocol: train fixed XGBoost weights in one database and evaluate without refitting in the other
transport.feature_scope: features with exact common definitions; 59 at 24 h, 99 at 48 h, 139 at 72 h
transport.interpretation: retrospective six-direction database-to-database transport, not prospective external validation or clinical utility

recalibration.stay_selection: retain the first target stay for each patient before repeated sampling
recalibration.sampling: deterministic outcome-stratified patient sample on the one-stay-per-patient target cohort
recalibration.model: multinomial logistic recalibrator using the three transported log-probabilities
recalibration.evaluation: remaining target patients disjoint from the calibration patients
recalibration.result_status: complete after the patient-disjoint sampling correction; mean 72 h top-label ECE 0.134-0.181 at 25 labels and 0.022-0.029 at 200 labels
recalibration.interpretation: direction-specific calibration learning curves; not a deployment policy or clinical-utility analysis

reassessment_simulation.interpretation: retrospective decision simulation; not clinical utility, workflow benefit, or prospective validation

artifacts.local_recalibration_status: Table 9 and Figure 9B-D report local recalibration; Figure 10A-F reports reassessment; Figure 11A-F reports sensitivity analyses; Figure 8A-D, Table 4, and Table 9 report hospital-held-out validation; Table 5 and Figure 4 report clinically meaningful transitions

ethics: each database accessed under its own DUA; no individual-level data shared; code available from the corresponding author on reasonable request
